environment.scope: Materialized pinned repository files; official fixed-version dependencies installed in a temporary directory; no database or real model

changes: Each current shared observation has concern:<concernId>:observation:<eventId>, original concern resourceId/version, and its own at
Concern title, state and reason are labeled as background; events are filtered by Hong Kong day before the shared 80-source cap
Known sources sort by actual timestamp then stable source ID, including equivalent timestamps expressed with different offsets
Undated concerns keep the prior source key and selection policy; no confirmed-action event is promoted to observation
Legacy dated aggregates are reconstructed only from current authority for exact ID/version/text validation, excluded from new entries and sourceBasis
No schema, store, PDF renderer, model prompt, source authority, or persistent data changes

checks.name: Directed workflow tests

checks.name: Strict source/store semantic typecheck
checks.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck --erasableSyntaxOnly server/family-document-sources.ts server/family-document-store.ts
checks.scope: Actual source/store and their transitive imported repository types; does not claim full-project or test-file semantic typechecking

checks.name: Baseline regression
checks.method: Run only the new quarter-boundary subtest with the pinned master family-document-sources.ts restored temporarily; then restore the final source
checks.observed: The original aggregation returns no Q1 observations after April observations are appended; expected three Q1 event sources

coverage: Quarter start/end at Hong Kong midnight; observations before and after the quarter excluded
Appending more than five later events does not remove an earlier in-period observation from a refreshed report
Closed concerns with in-period events remain usable; undated closed concerns and out-of-period dated concerns stay out
80-source cap across multiple concerns, offset-aware ordering and deterministic equal-instant source-ID tie-break
Current source IDs/resource IDs/versions and observation-date changes, source version changes and removals
Exact legacy snapshot remains readable and stale without rewriting; receipt replay, refreshed history and same-version PDF selection
Legacy source text/version changes and revocation invalidate old snapshot content, history, receipt and export
Existing checklist refresh, stale archive, PDF post-render recheck, child isolation and canonical report deduplication regressions
